text_en: But this was very displeasing to Jonah, and he became angry.
text_cn: 约纳因此很不高兴，遂发起怒来。

text_en: He prayed to the Lord and said, “O Lord ! Is not this what I said while I was still in my own country? That is why I fled to Tarshish at the beginning; for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love, and ready to relent from punishing.
text_cn: 他恳求天主说：“上主，当我还在故乡时，我岂不是已想到这事？所以，我预先要逃往塔尔史士去，因为我知道你是慈悲的，宽仁的天主；是缓于发怒，富于慈爱，怜悯而不愿降灾祸的天主。

text_en: And now, O Lord , please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live. ”
text_cn: 上主，现在，求你从我身上收去我的性命，因为，我死了比活着还好！”

text_en: And the Lord said, “Is it right for you to be angry? ”
text_cn: 上主说：“你的忿怒合理吗？”

text_en: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat down east of the city, and made a booth for himself there. He sat under it in the shade, waiting to see what would become of the city.
text_cn: 约纳出了城，坐在城东，在那里为自己搭了一个棚，坐在棚荫下，要看看那城究竟要发生什么事。

text_en: The Lord God appointed a bush, and made it come up over Jonah, to give shade over his head, to save him from his discomfort; so Jonah was very happy about the bush.
text_cn: 上主天主安排了一株篦麻，使它长的高过约纳，为他的头遮荫，消除他的烦恼。约纳很喜爱这株篦麻。

text_en: But when dawn came up the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the bush, so that it withered.
text_cn: 但第二天曙光升起时，天主安排了一个虫子咬死篦麻，篦麻便枯萎了。

text_en: When the sun rose, God prepared a sultry east wind, and the sun beat down on the head of Jonah so that he was faint and asked that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live. ”
text_cn: 当太阳升起时，天主又安排了炎热的东风，太阳射在约纳头上，使他无法忍受，遂要求死去，说：“我死了比活着还好！”

text_en: But God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the bush? ” And he said, “Yes, angry enough to die. ”
text_cn: 天主向约纳说：“你为这株篦麻发怒合理吗？”他回答说：“我发怒以至于死，是合理的！”

text_en: Then the Lord said, “You are concerned about the bush, for which you did not labor and which you did not grow; it came into being in a night and perished in a night.
text_cn: 上主说：“你为这株篦麻，并没有劳过力，也没有使它生长，还怜惜它：它不过是一夜生出，一夜死去的植物；

text_en: And should I not be concerned about Nineveh, that great city, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand persons who do not know their right hand from their left, and also many animals? ”
text_cn: 对尼尼微这座大城，其中有十二万多不能分辨自己左右手的人，且有许多牲畜，我就不该怜惜他们么？”
